summary: Find all descendants of a node
description: Given a fixed edge list and a target node, return every node that the target calls directly or transitively.
scope: Use a tiny in-memory chain A -> B -> C
Do not include the target itself
acceptanceCriteria: descendants(edges, 'B') for A->B and B->C returns C only, not A.
constraints: Strict TDD: write the failing test first and run it before implementation.
Do not add UI, watcher, or CLI code unless this task explicitly requires it.
Do not compute a highlight set.
